2608.02011.title: Before Reasoning Fails: Pre-Evidence Procedural Failures in Agentic RAG
2608.02011.paper_summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can fail before evidence-conditioned reasoning is tested: an agent may retrieve candidate snippets but finalize without inspecting them. We study this failure mode as a procedural property of the agent trajectory, decomposing wrong answers into pre-evidence discipline failures and post-gold-read failures using saved tool-call traces, retrieved evidence, read passages, and final answers. Across 12,000 paired trajectories on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, the two failure types are largely non-redundant: the both-trigger rate is in [11.2%, 13.1%] across regex and spaCy entity extractors. We then evaluate Read-Gate, a minimal runtime invariant requiring an agent to read after search and before finalization. Forced reading improves LLM-Acc by 14.9-19.9 points on trajectories that would otherwise skip reading and by 3.2-9.4 points on full minimal-reasoning cells. Additional diagnostics show that larger hidden thinking budgets do not necessarily increase evidence inspection. Together, these results indicate that evidence-gathering should be evaluated as a trajectory-level control problem, separately from answer-side reasoning.
2608.02011.paper_summary_zh: 代理檢索增強生成（RAG）系統可能在證據條件推理被測試之前就失敗：一個代理可能會檢索候選片段，但在未檢查它們的情況下就完成了。我們將這種失敗模式作為代理軌跡的一種程序性特徵進行研究，利用保存的工具調用痕跡、檢索到的證據、閱讀的段落和最終答案，將錯誤答案分解為前證據紀律失敗和後金讀取失敗。在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 MuSiQue 上的 12,000 對軌跡中，這兩種類型的失敗在很大程度上是非冗餘的：在 regex 和 spaCy 實體提取器中，兩者觸發率在 [11.2%, 13.1%] 之間。我們接著評估 Read-Gate，這是一個最小運行時不變性，要求代理在搜索後和最終化之前進行閱讀。強制閱讀使 LLM-Acc 在本來會跳過閱讀的軌跡上提高了 14.9-19.9 分，在完整的最小推理單元上提高了 3.2-9.4 分。額外的診斷顯示，更大的隱藏思考預算不一定會增加證據檢查。綜合這些結果表明，證據收集應被評估為一個軌跡級別的控制問題，與答案端推理分開。
2608.02011.author: Daeyoung Roh et.al.
